svg.title: Red Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Three curved edges preserve the photographed concave/convex character; control points approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://collection.themodern.org/objects/1783/red-panel; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
